claim_summary: The homepage counter labeled 'terrorists we eliminated' showed 3,600.
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye 2023-10-14 exact screenshot; IDF war diary 2023-10-12; Channel 14 2023-10-12 own article
resolution_notes: Accepted with a narrow False verdict. The contemporaneous IDF record and Channel 14's own Oct. 12 article both distinguished more than 3,600 targets attacked from hundreds of terrorists killed. Therefore the Oct. 14 homepage label assigning 3,600 to 'terrorists we eliminated' was factually wrong as a numeric label. Origin is preserved as Channel 14 graphic/chyron/website-counter editorial speech. No intent or methodology motive is inferred, and no correction was recovered.
